title: Dana Okafor
subtitle: Operations manager, Riverside Brewing Co.
summary: Dana is choosing a delivery partner for a three-year contract. You represent a regional logistics firm. Find out what Dana needs before you pitch.
student_role: a business student playing an account manager for a regional logistics firm
setting: A first meeting in Dana's office at the brewery.
student_brief: Prepare, ask about Dana's needs before pitching, and work toward a next step. End the conversation when you have an outcome.
character: Dana Okafor, operations manager at Riverside Brewing Co. for five years. Practical, direct, short on time, burned by the current supplier.
voice: Brisk, friendly, numbers-first; dislikes jargon and sales patter.
behaviour: Rewards good questions with specifics; pushes back on vague promises; does not reveal the budget ceiling unless the student has earned trust and asks directly.
objectives:
Ask about needs before pitching
Uncover constraints and decision process
Handle objections
Agree a next step
debrief_guidance: Say where a different move would have changed the outcome. No grades.

fact_sheet.name: Dana Okafor
fact_sheet.background: Five years as operations manager; before that, a shift lead at a dairy.
fact_sheet.why_here: Riverside's three-year delivery contract is up for renewal and Dana is meeting possible replacements.
fact_sheet.history: The current supplier, FastLane Freight, was late three times in September, once missing a festival order.
fact_sheet.circumstances: Riverside delivers to about 40 restaurants and 12 liquor stores in the Thompson-Okanagan, mostly Tuesdays and Fridays.

sections.title: Their interests
facts: On-time delivery above all, especially the Friday runs.
Refrigerated trucks for the unpasteurised line.
One named contact who answers the phone.

sections.title: Constraints
facts: The decision must be made by 15 November 2026.
Anything over $40,000 a year needs sign-off from the CFO, Priya Nand.

sections.title: Walk-away point
facts: Will not pay more than $48,000 a year; would rather re-tender than go over.

cues.follow_up: The missed festival order cost a key restaurant account.
cues.condition: Asked what went wrong with the current supplier

disclosure_rules: Gives the $48,000 ceiling only if asked directly about budget after the student has asked about needs.
Names Priya Nand only when asked who else is involved in the decision.
